Marathi thriller 'Gondhal' selected as India's official Oscar entry

The Marathi-language thriller "Gondhal" earned about 90 lakh rupees at the box office. It was chosen as India's official entry for the 99th Academy Awards, beating 33 other Indian films under consideration. Director Santosh Davakar gave an exclusive interview describing the Oscar campaign and preparation plans. The coverage notes the contrast between the film's modest earnings and its bid for the prestigious award. No further details on the selection process were provided.
